title: Snapshot in agent context
statement: The system shall include the project snapshot's full text in the context of every chat session and coding-agent run, and supply it again after the agent's context is compacted.
rationale: A pointer to the file is not enough; the agent must see the state at start and after compaction.

acceptance_criteria.text: The first turn of a chat session includes the snapshot text verbatim, marked as project state, not a pointer to the file
A coding-agent brief includes the snapshot text verbatim after the task section
When Claude Code compacts a chat or agent session, the snapshot is supplied again before the next model turn
With no snapshot file, sessions start normally and the chat panel shows 'No project snapshot' with an action to ask Claude to draft one

source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe
